correctness.rationale: Final assessment of /workspace/repairs/1/RESULT.md. The original enumerator and scope survive unchanged. The original prior-work paragraph reversed the bipartiteness parity: the alternating parts of the 2m-cycle are crossed by the antipodal chords exactly when m is odd. The repair corrects that assertion and clarifies what is (and is not) known about palettes for the weaker dynamic condition. For correctness of the census, a state is a pair of proper vertically and horizontally compatible columns. A step checks the two neighborhoods of its middle column. A walk from the initial pair to its row swap checks all m columns across the seam; labels specify the start, so no orbit division is justified. Row swap commutes with the transfer and gives two 42-dimensional sectors; independent reconstruction and exact coefficient computation reproduced both characteristic determinants (all 43 coefficients in each), cancellation at m=1,2, and the eight initial values. The trace/logarithmic derivative identity therefore decides every m≥3, not merely sampled widths. With three colours, the swapped-adjacent type cannot transition, since the next column would have equal entries. The other two types transition only along their respective oriented 3-cycles, which the seam interchanges. Smaller palettes embed into three, so no counted colouring omits a colour. The explicit two-step return and twisted three- and four-step walks in the repair pass the local tests and yield all m≥3. Reciprocal root bounds for the remaining polynomials are strict on |x|=3; the positive root 1+√5 occurs once only in the positive sector and contributes with coefficient one. The negative counterpart has modulus below three. No Jordan correction is needed for traces of matrix powers.

value.rationale: The exact-two condition is a natural locally mixed alternative to the known coherent/rainbow or dynamic conditions on a standard cubic family. The transfer must handle the actual Möbius seam and does more than recover palette feasibility: it proves a complete labelled enumerator and singles out the precise exponential rate. In particular, the larger conflict-free class already differs sharply at widths four and five; the precise counts and growth are meaningful comparators for constrained graph-colouring models and twisted transfer methods. The parity and palette-credit repair does not change these contributions.
residual_risks: No assertion for larger palettes, graph automorphism orbits, untwisted prisms or all cubic graphs.
